title: CRASH-081: array filter stale argstack zvalpp across callback uaf (use-after-free)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free at ext/standard/array.c:3938 in zif_array_filter when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src e615889d6b43, which postdates the release, and names the defect at ext/standard/array.c:3938 (also 3903-3905, 3914)
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build crashes on it natively, so a silence on an arm is not a MISSED: the judge reads such a case out of the denominator unless an arm faults at the ASan site.
